body.name: T_Lip
body.construction: Set \(b_n=\max\{n^{-1/5},\epsilon^{1/4}\}\) and return \(0\) if \(b_n>1/4\). Otherwise let \(h_n\) be the least dyadic number at least \(b_n\), construct the explicitly endpointed cells \(\mathcal D_n\), compute every bounded zero-safe arm mean \(\widehat m_a(D)\), reuse \(B_n=[h_n,2h_n]\) for boundary reconstruction, and return \(T_{\mathrm{Lip}}=\operatorname{clip}_{[-1/2,1/2]}[\sum_{D\in\mathcal D_n}|D|\{\widehat m_1(D)-\widehat m_0(D)\}+h_n\{\widehat m_1(B_n)-\widehat m_0(B_n)\}]\). A single pass assigns records to slabs and cells and accumulates arm counts and outcome sums.
